repos.name: CleanYourTV
repos.blurb: The project that started the October 2026 wave. Debloats almost any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and replaces the ad-heavy stock home with a calm, Apple TV-style launcher. Ships per-brand package lists covering 150+ models.
repos.best: Start here if you want one guided flow instead of hand-picking tools.

repos.name: Universal Android Debloater (UAD)
repos.blurb: The long-standing cross-platform GUI for removing pre-installed packages over ADB without root. Community-maintained package lists label what is safe to remove, what is questionable, and what will break things.
repos.best: Power users who want a visual package manager for any Android device, TV included.

repos.name: Free My TV
repos.blurb: A fast, ad-free home screen that goes beyond Android: it also covers LG webOS and Samsung Tizen sets that ADB tools cannot touch. Every change has a one-button undo.
repos.best: LG and Samsung owners who are locked out of the Android TV toolbox.

repos.name: Android TV Debloat Toolkit
repos.blurb: A lightweight Python toolkit to debloat a TV, sideload APKs and apply common tweaks from one menu-driven script.
repos.best: A small, readable script you can audit before you run it.

repos.name: Clean Android TV
repos.blurb: Plain ADB shell scripts plus a step-by-step guide to debloat and speed up an Android TV. Nothing hidden: every command is in the open.
repos.best: Minimalists who prefer raw ADB commands over GUI tools.

repos.name: Debloat TCL Android TV
repos.blurb: A TCL-focused debloat script set: the exact packages one TCL owner removed, with notes on what each one does.
repos.best: TCL owners who want a model-family-specific list instead of a generic one.

repos.name: TCL Debloat
repos.blurb: A second, independent TCL bloatware removal list. Useful as a cross-check before disabling anything on a TCL set.
repos.best: Cross-checking a TCL package before you disable it.

repos.name: Aerial TV
repos.blurb: A tvOS-inspired open-source launcher built for China-market TVs (Xiaomi, TCL and others): no ads, no recommendations row, and it takes over the home button on boot.
repos.best: Xiaomi / TCL owners who want a clean Chinese-market-friendly home screen.

repos.name: AndroidTVLauncher
repos.blurb: One of the oldest open Leanback-style launchers. Plain grid, no feeds, no ads — a safe baseline replacement for the stock home on older boxes.
repos.best: Older Android TV boxes that struggle with heavier launchers.

repos.name: TV Launcher (nielsvanvelzen)
repos.blurb: An experimental, deliberately simple big-screen launcher from a Jellyfin contributor. Clean rows, quick search, nothing trying to sell you content.
repos.best: Trying a lightweight modern launcher that stays out of the way.

repos.name: LtvLauncher
repos.blurb: A minimal open-source launcher with a Wi-Fi data-usage widget and an OLED-friendly built-in screensaver. Built for calm, dark living rooms.
repos.best: OLED owners who want burn-in-aware, minimal home screens.

repos.name: Tigris
repos.blurb: A tvOS 26-style launcher with a Liquid Glass dock, Top Shelf and a glass control center, plus photo screensavers. The most design-forward option in this wave.
repos.best: If the Apple TV look is the whole point, this is the closest match.

repos.name: Monet Launcher
repos.blurb: An Android TV launcher with Material You dynamic colors. Ships sideloadable APKs for devices the Play Store refuses to serve.
repos.best: Google TV sticks where the Play Store marks other launchers incompatible.

repos.name: Guizang TV
repos.blurb: A simple big-text Android home screen tuned for Xiaomi TVs in China: large-type lists, wallpaper rotation and one-tap HDMI inputs for parents and grandparents.
repos.best: Setting up a TV for older family members on a Xiaomi set.

repos.name: TV Home ZH
repos.blurb: An Apple TV-style launcher for Android TV with a ready-to-install APK — no building from source. Chinese-language build of the tv-home idea.
repos.best: You want the tv-home look with a prebuilt APK and Chinese UI.

repos.name: Glass TV
repos.blurb: Debloats your TV over Wi-Fi, then lands you on a glass-style home screen. Part of the October wave of CleanYourTV-inspired all-in-ones.
repos.best: A newer all-in-one alternative if CleanYourTV does not fit your model.

repos.name: DumbTV
repos.blurb: The Fire TV counterpart of the wave: removes ads, tracking and clutter over ADB with no root, and every step can be undone. Ends on a quiet, minimal home screen.
repos.best: Fire TV Stick and Fire TV Edition owners — start here.

repos.name: Fire TV Glass Launcher
repos.blurb: Debloats a Fire TV Stick and replaces Amazon's home screen with Glass, a small and fast launcher that does not phone home.
repos.best: A launcher-only swap after you have already debloated.

repos.name: Fire TV Clean Root Toolkit
repos.blurb: Native launcher replacement, bloatware disablement and an in-memory root toolkit for Fire OS 7 devices. Advanced and device-specific — read the warnings first.
repos.best: Advanced users on Fire OS 7 who understand the root risks.

repos.name: TV Home
repos.blurb: Debloat a slow, ad-filled TV over Wi-Fi and give it a fast Apple TV-style home — driven by a single prompt to your coding agent, with the repo holding the resulting setup.
repos.best: Seeing how the one-prompt workflow compares with CleanYourTV.

repos.name: TV Detox
repos.blurb: Make an old Android TV fast again with Claude Code or Codex: a tiny ad-free home screen plus the exact prompt used to clean the TV up.
repos.best: You already use Claude Code / Codex and want the prompt, not an app.

repos.name: TV Vibehack
repos.blurb: Reverse-engineers your TV's stock behaviour: fail-safe direct-boot launcher, remote hotkey remapping and deep settings access, all agent-driven.
repos.best: Tinkerers who want to remap remote buttons and boot straight into a clean home.

repos.name: UrTV
repos.blurb: An Arabic home screen and Saudi screensaver for Android / Google TV plus a safe speed-up pass, set up by your AI agent.
repos.best: Arabic-speaking households — the only localized option in this wave.

repos.name: CleanYourTV Phone App (community)
repos.blurb: A community-built phone companion for CleanYourTV: clean up an Android TV from your phone, with no laptop and no coding agent in the loop.
repos.best: No computer available — run the cleanup from your phone instead.

repos.name: SmartTube
repos.blurb: The most popular open YouTube client for TVs: no ads, SponsorBlock built in, and a UI designed for the remote. The natural finishing touch after a debloat.
repos.best: Replacing the stock YouTube app on any Android TV or Fire TV.

repos.name: Kodi
repos.blurb: The award-winning open media center. Heavy, endlessly extensible, and completely free of the recommendation feeds that clutter stock TV homes.
repos.best: A full media-center hub for local files and your own library.

repos.name: Jellyfin for Android TV
repos.blurb: The official Android TV client for the Jellyfin media server. Your library, your home screen, no tracking and no upsells.
repos.best: You run (or want) a Jellyfin server for your own media.

repos.name: scrcpy
repos.blurb: Mirror and control an Android device from your computer over USB or Wi-Fi. Indispensable while setting up a TV: type, click and install with keyboard and mouse.
repos.best: Driving the TV setup from your laptop instead of the remote.

repos.name: Aerial Views
repos.blurb: The Apple TV aerial videos as a proper screensaver for Android TV, Google TV, Shield and Fire TV — including Dolby Vision clips on supported sets.
repos.best: Finishing the Apple TV look with the matching screensaver.

repos.name: SmartTV Toolkit
repos.blurb: A Windows batch-file toolkit collecting common smart-TV ADB jobs: debloat batches, APK installs and launcher swaps in menu form.
repos.best: Windows users who want the common jobs pre-scripted.

repos.name: Android TV Toolkit
repos.blurb: A brand-agnostic debugging and tuning toolbox: ADB authorization helpers, per-brand sideloading notes, ad removal and a status HUD.
repos.best: Troubleshooting ADB authorization across different TV brands.
